description: Defines the ShopOrder class representing an e-commerce order with associated details such as shopping cart items, shipping info, payment, and order summary.

classes.name: ShopOrder
classes.description: Represents a customer's order with shopping cart items, shipping details, payment info, and order total summary.

methods.name: setShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Sets the list of shopping cart items associated with the order.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of shopping cart items in the order.

methods.name: setOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Sets the total summary of the order displayed to the user.

methods.name: getOrderTotalSummary
methods.description: Retrieves the total summary of the order.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Returns the shipping summary information for the order.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the error message, if any.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message related to the order.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodType
methods.description: Gets the payment method type selected by the user.
